Customer Care

Shipping, Delivery & Returns Policy

Transparent, secure, and reliable policies for every order placed with Kalyani Sarees Dhanpatganj.

1. Domestic Shipping & Delivery Timelines

• Dispatch Schedule: All orders are securely inspected, wrapped in moisture-resistant protective packaging, and dispatched within 24 to 48 business hours from our Dhanpatganj facility.

• Delivery Window: Standard domestic delivery takes 3 to 6 business days depending on your delivery postal code. Express delivery options are available for major metros and Tier 1 cities.

• Shipping Charges: We provide Complimentary Express Shipping on all prepaid and COD orders totaling ₹2,999 or above. Orders below ₹2,999 incur a flat ₹150 logistics fee across India.

2. 7-Day Hassle-Free Exchange Policy

We want you to love your drape. If the color, weave, or size does not meet your expectations, we gladly offer an exchange within 7 days of delivery.

  • Garments must be unworn, unwashed, and returned in their original packaging with all security tags intact.
  • Sarees with unstitched blouse pieces cut or altered cannot be accepted for return or exchange.
  • To initiate an exchange, please contact our customer care via WhatsApp or email with your order details.

3. Tamper-Evident Bridal Packaging

High-value Banarasi silk sarees and bridal lehengas are dispatched inside hard-bound protective keepsake boxes and wrapped in breathable muslin cloth to prevent any friction damage to delicate gold and silver zari threads during transit.
